_comment: Gate for /editorial-policy/. This is a client site: the page publishes only once the client has approved the text in data/system/editorial_policy_full.txt in writing. Until then the build does not write it and prints NAMED_STOP: EDITORIAL_POLICY_AWAITING_CLIENT_APPROVAL. To release: set client_approved true, approved_on to the date of the written approval, and approval_record to where that approval is kept (no private names here). Guarded by _ops/validators/validate_editorial_policy_gate.js.
